Shipping & Delivery
Shipping:

We strive to deliver products purchased from Cycle.in in excellent condition and in the fastest time possible. Delivery charges as applicable may be charged for your orders.

With every order, you will receive an email containing the details of the order placed by you. Once we ship the item(s), you will receive another email containing the shipping details. Kindly note that the AWB (delivery tracking codes) might take time from the courier end to get updated although the package could have been picked up by the courier.

Delivery:
We process all deliveries through reputed couriers.

If there is no courier service available in your area, we will ship your items via India Post’s Book post/ Speed post/parcel service.

We ship within 2 working days for deliveries in India. The estimated time of delivery may vary from 2-7 working days to all the areas serviced by reputed couriers. For other areas, orders will be sent by India Post’s Book post/ Speed post/parcel service which may take 1-2 weeks depending on the location and the delivery policy of the India Post. Business days exclude public holidays and Sundays.

For Custom Incense products, due to their made-to-order nature, we may need 7-10 days for shipping the products from our warehouse. Courier transit time at actuals would be additional.

Akhand Jyoti products are made-to-order, so we require 7-10 days for shipping from our warehouse. Products will be dispatched via our trucks through our depots, with delivery handled by our in-house team. As we do not use third-party logistics services for this product, tracking numbers will not be provided, but a shipping confirmation email would be sent to you.

Incorrect Shipping Information: 

You are required to provide proper and complete shipping information at the time of placing the order in Cycle.in. Once the products are shipped or out for delivery., you shall not change, modify, edit or vary the Shipping address.

 In such case of incorrect shipping information, the product will be returned to us by delivering partner/courier service   and on our decision, coupon code or store credit will be provided to you. 

Though we regret such inconvenience, we shall not be held responsible for any loss or delay or for any claim due to an incorrect shipping information provided by you at the time of placing of Order.

Apart from condition reserved herein above, the following products shall not be eligible for return or replacement if:

Any product that is returned without all original packaging and accessories, including the retail box, manuals, cables, and all other items originally included with the product at the time of delivery;
Any product without a valid, readable, un-tampered serial number, including but not limited to products with missing, damaged, altered, or otherwise unreadable serial number;
Any product from which the EAN (International article Number) has been removed from its original packaging.
Any product which is made exclusively for the customer.

Requests that do not include these supporting documents may not be eligible for a refund. NRRS's decision shall be final and binding. (6) Cancellations by the Customer: In case we receive a cancellation request, and the order has not been shipped by us, we shall cancel the order and refund the entire amount. The orders that have already been shipped out by us will not be cancelled and you will have to check our return policy on those orders. In case of customized products, no cancellations are allowed once the ordered item has been taken up for production. The customer agrees not to dispute the decision made by us and accept our decision as binding regarding the cancellation.
